verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online imports bank and card transactions automatically (docs-7) and claims to "automatically sort expenses" (docs-28). A community user confirms built-in rule-based transaction categorization (comm-3). However, nothing in the evidence shows the suggestions adapt or learn from the user's corrections; the rules described appear user-defined rather than learned. missing for 10: evidence that categorization learns from user corrections, documentation of how suggestions are generated for imported transactions, independent hands-on corroboration of suggestion accuracy.
